category: managed authoritative DNS with a REST API

free_tier.stated: Solo has no base subscription fee and a free 30-day trial, but every hosted zone costs USD 0.50 per month and Solo includes 50,000 queries per zone per month then USD 0.80 per million; activation needs a card. No standing free allowance exists after the one-time trial

per_object_cap.stated: 100 DNS records per zone on Solo, including system records; a zone on Solo cannot grow above the limit, and records above it cannot be added until some are deleted or the plan is changed

retention.stated: zones persist while the subscription is active; the 30-day free trial is available once, and the card on file is charged when the trial ends unless the account cancels first

egress.terms: the metered quantity is authoritative DNS queries, not bytes out; a zone within its included query allowance has no query fee, and volume above it is billed per million queries
egress.free_allowance: 50,000 queries per zone per month on Solo

interface_detail: the DNSimple API is a REST web service API that provides access to domains, zones, records and certificates, authenticated with an access token; the official DNSimple CLI is a command-line interface for that API, and a Terraform provider is published
tooling: the DNSimple CLI, Terraform provider dnsimple/dnsimple, and official API client libraries for Ruby, Go, Elixir, Node.js, .NET, Java, PHP, Python and Rust
chaining: an authoritative DNS host with a full REST API and CLI, usable as primary or secondary DNS, with DNSSEC and Anycast, that a reader scripts against via token; every active zone carries a monthly charge

limits.value: 100 DNS records per zone on Solo, including system records; the zone cannot go above the limit
2,400 API requests per hour per account by default, 30 per hour per IP unauthenticated, 60 domain availability checks per hour per account
the 30-day free trial is available once; the card is charged when the trial ends unless cancelled first

binding_note: there is no standing free allowance: the 30-day trial ends once and then every active zone costs USD 0.50 per month, so the trial clock binds before the 100-record cap or the API request rate does

identity_cost.detail: the signup form asks for an email address and a password of at least 16 characters with two character types, and offers Google sign-in; an account can be created and the dashboard explored without a plan, but activation to add records needs payment details, and every self-service plan including Solo requires a credit or debit card with no alternative payment method (https://app.dnsimple.com/signup, https://support.dnsimple.com/articles/account-creation, https://support.dnsimple.com/articles/payment-methods, https://support.dnsimple.com/articles/account-activation/)

reliability_note: the API returns HTTP 429 when the hourly or per-IP request limit is reached; an expired email verification link after 7 days blocks subscribing and registering until a new one is requested
confidence_note: the pricing page, plans, DNS query limits, DNS record limits, API rate limit, account creation, account activation, payment methods, signup form, developer documentation and CLI article were first-party pages read and quoted; the card requirement is documented on the payment and activation pages rather than at a live checkout; no live DNS read was probed

notes: The Solo plan has no base fee but no standing free allowance: a one-time 30-day trial, then USD 0.50 per active zone per month plus query volume above 50,000 per zone. A card is required to activate even the free tier. The free tier uses unit none because there is no recurring free amount; the trial is described in retention and the limits rows. No live DNS read was probed. The CLI and Terraform provider are clients of the hosted API, not self-hosted software.
